result.title: CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation
result.comment: Accepted at the CARE 2026 Workshop at MICCAI 2026
result.summary: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement. At inference, source-free test-time adaptation based on confidence-filtered predictions and probability-prior regularization further improves robustness to out-of-distribution inputs. As a final deterministic post-processing step, largest connected component filtering removes isolated false-positive regions. On the CARE 2026 test set, CIRSeg achieves Dice scores of 97.13\% and 97.93\% on the in-domain and unseen-domain subsets, with corresponding HD95 values of 20.18 mm and 11.30 mm, respectively. These results demonstrate consistently accurate segmentation across both in-domain and unseen acquisition settings. The code is available at https://github.com/jingkunchen/MICCAI_CARE_2026

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 CIRSeg，基于 nnU-Netv2 的由粗到精肝脏分割框架，结合 3D CutMix 与强度迁移增强、级联定位-细化结构、无源测试时自适应与连通域后处理，以提升 MRI 强度变化下的分割鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于医学图像分割的域泛化与测试时自适应应用，未涉及多模态推理中的 latent 状态生成、证据使用或停止决策，也无状态抽象或决策层面的可迁移线索。
